insight: Raised a $30M Series B at a roughly $200M valuation, co-led by Cherryrock Capital and Emerson Collective.
name: Coactive AI
tagline: Multimodal platform that makes images and video searchable and structured.
description: Coactive AI is an enterprise multimodal application platform that pulls context directly from the pixels and audio in images and video — no manual tagging or metadata required. Teams use it to semantically search, label, govern, and structure large visual libraries at scale, turning unstructured media into queryable data. It is aimed at media, retail, and other enterprises with vast image and video archives.

modelSupport.notes: Runs Coactive's own multimodal embedding models over your visual data.

edge: Reads meaning straight from pixels and audio, so visual archives become searchable without the manual tagging legacy DAM tools demand.
pros: Search visual data with no tagging
Structures and governs media as data
cons: Not a self-serve or hobbyist tool
